title: Healthcare workforce sustainability and planning
asked: Dr Choo Pei Ling asked how Singapore is strengthening long-term healthcare workforce sustainability while maintaining care standards, and whether workforce planning assumptions are being reviewed for resilience amid tightening regional labour markets.
response: Dr Koh Poh Koon said ensuring an adequate healthcare workforce to meet rising healthcare demand is a foremost priority for the Ministry. He described a multi-pronged strategy: building the local core through diversifying training pathways, increasing local intakes, and competitive salaries; bringing in qualified foreign healthcare workers in shortfall areas; diversifying foreign recruitment sources; and securing government-to-government manpower agreements with regional countries. He said plans are regularly updated as circumstances change, and that preventive health and right-siting patients to appropriate care settings will help keep the system sustainable.

key_points.point: Ensuring an adequate healthcare workforce to meet rising demand is a foremost priority for the Ministry.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: ensuring an adequate healthcare workforce to meet rising healthcare demand is a foremost priority for the Ministry

key_points.point: The Ministry uses a multi-pronged workforce strategy and regularly updates plans as circumstances change.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: We adopt a multi-pronged workforce strategy to ensure sufficient healthcare manpower while maintaining care standards and regularly update our plans as circumstances change.

key_points.point: It builds the local core by diversifying training pathways, increasing local intakes, and making jobs attractive with competitive salaries.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: build up the local core of our healthcare workforce through diversifying training pathways, increasing local intakes for healthcare programmes and ensuring that job roles are attractive and salaries are competitive

key_points.point: It brings in qualified foreign healthcare workers in areas of shortfall.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: We bring in qualified foreign healthcare workers in areas of shortfall.

key_points.point: To ensure resilience, it diversifies foreign recruitment sources and secures government-to-government manpower agreements with regional countries.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we diversify the sources of foreign recruitment and secure government-to-government bilateral manpower cooperation agreements with regional countries

key_points.point: Care models are shifting from team-based care to a shared care model with cross-training in adjacent domains.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we are shifting from more team-based care to a more shared care model, in which we allow more cross training among the healthcare professionals in adjacent domains

key_points.point: Care team transformation includes having someone other than a specialist coordinate care.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: change the idea of a specialist being always the principal doctor in charge of a patient to having someone else who can coordinate the care other than a specialist

key_points.point: Retention efforts include making salaries competitive compared to other sectors.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: making sure the salary is competitive compared to other sectors

key_points.point: Professionals are allowed to practise at the top of their licence.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: practise at the top of their licence

key_points.point: Each healthcare cluster has a Chief Welfare Officer for staff welfare initiatives.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: each of our healthcare clusters have a Chief Welfare Officer that looks at the welfare initiatives

key_points.point: There are systems to prevent workplace harassment and abuse, with a zero tolerance stance.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we also have systems in place to prevent harassment and abuse at the workplace of our healthcare professionals and we take a zero tolerance stance

key_points.point: New career tracks include hospital clinicians for doctors.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we are creating a new category of career track for doctors. We call them hospital clinicians.

key_points.point: In primary care, the pool of family medicine specialists will grow, with family medicine designated as a specialty.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we will grow the pool of family medicine specialists, designating family medicine as a specialty itself

key_points.point: There are no plans to turn foreign domestic workers into healthcare professionals in the formal sense.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we have no plans to turn foreign domestic workers into healthcare professionals in the formal sense

left_open: Whether specific workforce planning assumptions are being reviewed amid tightening regional labour markets.
supplementary: Supplementary questions covered care model redesign, retention of senior staff, workforce planning alignment, and professionalising foreign domestic workers for care roles.
